title: Microsoft Teams: AI Interpreter for town halls and webinars
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts and documented policy paths and commands are supported. It correctly distinguishes the planned events capability from Interpreter in meetings; licensing should acknowledge the published Teams requirement while retaining the narrower gap about events interpretation.

claims.fix: Set licensing.model to included to reflect the published product-level requirement, and begin licensing.notes and the licensing paragraph with: 'Teams requires a Teams license for each user in the organisation, except for joining meetings anonymously. Do not claim that a Teams license alone entitles users to events interpretation.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -AIInterpreter Disabled disables Interpreter in meetings for the policy.

claims.claim: The meeting AIInterpreter parameter is enabled by default.
